name: omnibase/booking
description: Reserved, not released yet: a ready-made travel-agency structure for omnibase sites - trips, stays and bookings, built on omnisense/omnistay (lodging, car hire, packages) and omnisense/omnitravel (timetables, itineraries), so an agency site integrates these components quickly.

suggest.omnisense/omnistay: the lodging, car-hire and package providers it books through
suggest.omnisense/omnitravel: the timetables and itineraries it shows for a trip
